bull_bear.body: - INR 5,000 cr equity + INR 1,000 cr Tier-2 approved, to be raised Q3/Q4 FY27 (GoI 92.44%; also helps SEBI MPS). CAR already 19.36% vs 11.50% min — raise is offensive/growth + float, not distress. Accumulated losses fully cleared this quarter (enables future dividend capacity). ECL being front-loaded (no 4-yr dispensation) — conservative capital use.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- **"Quality of beat":** PSLC INR 863 cr + tech-w/o recovery ~INR 490 cr are large; mgmt calls them recurring, but they inflate the headline vs pure operating earnings.
- **Corporate-book contraction:** -10% QoQ; recovery to +12–13% is a FY27-end promise to verify.
- **SMA2 tick-up:** +INR 500 cr QoQ (though total SMA down INR 2,200 cr) — monitor slippage.
- **Dilution / MPS optics:** INR 5,000 cr raise with GoI at 92.44%.
- **West Asia conflict:** "looming large again"; no product/sector stress seen yet in SME/small-borrower book.
- **ECLGS tail:** INR 1,800 cr still to disburse; CGTMSE/CGFMU cover ~15–16% of credit.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Highly confident, "consistency is our hallmark" tone from CEO Srivastava (11-quarter one-directional track record). Candid on the corporate-book exit rationale ("we do not want to do any loss-making business… not for sub-7% corporate"), transparent on ECL front-loading and the SMA2 uptick, and precise on data points (DTA/MTM bridge, SMA buckets, ECLGS split). Guides conservatively (13–14% "minimum") while over-delivering — a credibility-builder. No over-promising on NIM (held-band framing).
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- A PSB printing **ROE 22.7% / ROA 1.41% / NIM 3.48% domestic** — better than most private peers — yet still trades/optically screens as a PSU; the re-rating question is whether the market fully credits the earnings quality.
- The **-10% QoQ corporate book is self-inflicted discipline**, not demand loss — a positive read once the +12–13% FY27 recovery lands.
- **Accumulated losses now nil** is a quiet but structural milestone (dividend capacity + cleaner capital math ahead of the raise).
- ECL being **fully provided within FY27 (no 4-yr dispensation)** removes a future overhang other PSBs will still be carrying.
- PSLC + tech-w/o recovery recurring "every quarter for 8–9 quarters" is the crux of the bull/bear debate on sustainable ROA.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Capital position at Jun-26: CRAR 19.36% (18.28% at Jun-25, +108 bps), CET 1 and Tier 1 both 16.88% (₹36,081 Cr), Tier 2 2.47% (₹5,283 Cr), total capital ₹41,364 Cr against total RWA of ₹2,13,713 Cr.
- RWA efficiency improved year on year: total RWA to advance ratio 66.34% (68.27% at Jun-25) and credit RWA to advance ratio 57.57% (58.56%), though both rose from Mar-26 levels of 63.76% and 55.78%.
- Returns as stated: ROE 22.69% at Jun-26 rising each quarter from 19.00%, and ROA 1.41% from 1.14%.
- Book value per share ₹15.79 at Jun-26 (₹12.41 at Jun-25) and adjusted book value ₹15.48, with price/book at 2.16x versus 3.14x a year earlier and P/E at 39.64 versus 67.21.
- The deck states no dividend, no capital-raising plan and no GoI-stake-dilution roadmap despite the 92.44% government holding.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- **RAM (~80% of book):** primary yield + growth engine; big-ticket MSME/agri loans (INR 3–5 cr) classified RAM per RBI definition. Gold-backed = ~40% of agriculture general loans; no agri delinquencies seen/expected.
- **Corporate (~20%):** -10% QoQ purely from exiting one ~INR 10,000 cr low-priced account in Apr (~40% of impact absorbed in Q1); disciplined "no loss-making business at sub-7%".
- **International:** 4 countries; new GIFT City IFSC branch upcoming.
- **Digital:** ~96% of transactions digital; ~75% of customer onboarding digital; 10-min laptop/mobile loan sanction, 2-min digital locker allotment (Big-Four-led revamp 3–4 yrs ago).
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
> PSB earnings call — mostly firm-specific execution; limited clean sector-reallocation mapping. Kept minimal to avoid padding.

| FCNR(B) leverage / NRI-deposit push amid "dispensation window ending Sep" | IOB (self) + other PSBs racing FCNR(B) inflows | — | Sector-wide NRI-flow grab, not a reallocation to one listed name — **Low** |

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers (listed names)

business.body:
- Government of India holds 92.44% of the shareholding as on 30.06.2026, with institutions at 4.83% and individuals at 2.73% — the deck's own pie labels.
- The book is deliberately RAM-led: RAM to Advances rose to 81.21% at Jun-26 from 73.39% at Jun-25 (+782 bps), while Corporate/others advances shrank to ₹44,405 Cr from ₹51,450 Cr (-13.69% YoY).
- Asset quality is presented as the core structural story: GNPA% down to 1.33% at Jun-26 from 1.97% at Jun-25 (64 bps) and from 9.82% at Mar-22; NNPA% at 0.18% from 0.32%; PCR at 97.67%.
- Financial inclusion and government-scheme distribution are a stated franchise plank: 96.25 lakh PMJDY accounts at Jun-26 (89.63 lakh at Jun-25) with ₹4,200 Cr PMJDY balances, and Jansuraksha enrolments of PMJJBY 49.70 lakh, PMSBY 102.38 lakh and APY 20.78 lakh at Jun-26.
- Deck claims IOB is "Amongst top 2 PSBs in number of loan disbursement via ULI" (RBIH Unified Lending Interface).
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Overseas book] Overseas advances of ₹16,133 Cr carry an 8.68% NPA ratio at Jun-26 — versus 0.95% domestic — and overseas NPAs of ₹1,399 Cr actually rose from ₹1,347 Cr at Jun-25 while domestic NPAs fell; the deck presents the table without commentary on this divergence.
- [NPA reduction mix] The Jun-26 quarter's gross NPA reduction of ₹316 Cr comprised cash recoveries ₹106 Cr, upgradation ₹35 Cr, write-offs ₹174 Cr and nil sale to ARCs, against fresh slippages of ₹195 Cr; recovery from technical write-off accounts was ₹497 Cr.
- [Two PCR definitions] The deck reports PCR on two bases and they differ materially: 97.67% including technical write-off versus 86.29% excluding technical write-off at Jun-26 — the headline slides quote only the 97.67% figure.
- [Award] Skoch Award for the "Compliance Apexion" project, unveiled by MD & CEO Shri Ajay Kumar Srivastava with EDs Shri Joydeep Dutta Roy and Shri Dhanaraj T.
- [Balance sheet units] The 30.06.2026 balance sheet is presented in Rs. In Lakhs (total ₹4,80,95,649 lakhs standalone) while every other slide is in Rs. In Crores — a unit switch to watch when comparing across slides.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body:
- NIM 3.37% global / 3.48% domestic; +12 bps QoQ. Levers: yield on advances +10 bps QoQ (better pricing; 54% MCLR / 37% RLLR-linked) + cost of deposits -10 bps QoQ (aggressive CASA @ ~41%, bulk deposits kept to just 6–7% of total, all TD repricing already complete). Future ROA uplift framed as NIM-driven (both higher interest income and lower interest expense).
- Fee income +20% YoY to INR 476 cr (from 398 cr) — low-base optics; core exchange/commission/LC/BG/locker/processing.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
- **Q1FY27 (this):** PAT INR 1,659 cr (+49.3%, all-time high), OP INR 2,693 cr (+14.2%), NII +34.3%, NIM 3.37% global / 3.48% dom, ROA 1.41%, ROE 22.69%, CAR 19.36%. Advances INR 3,22,132 cr (+22.75%; corp -10% QoQ), Deposits INR 3,76,193 cr (+13.72%), CASA 41.45%. GNPA 1.33% / NNPA 0.18% / PCR 97.67% / slippage 0.06%; SMA 4.05%. PSLC INR 863 cr, tech-w/o recovery ~INR 490 cr. Accumulated losses wiped to nil. Guidance: advances 13–14% min, corp +12–13% FY27, NIM 3.3–3.4%, ROA ~1.46% FY27, credit cost 0.35–0.40%, ECL fully provided in FY27, INR 5,000 cr equity + 1,000 cr Tier-2 Q3/Q4, GIFT City USD 500 mn, FCNR(B) → USD 600–650 mn by Sep.
- _next → check: corporate book turning back to growth (+12–13% path); NIM held 3.3–3.4%; ROA toward 1.46%; PSLC/recovery recurrence (sustainability of beat); ECLGS 95–100% disbursed; capital raise execution + pricing; GIFT City book build; FCNR(B) doubling; SMA2 trajectory._

outlook.body:
- **Credit / advances growth:** 13–14% **minimum** FY27 (has run ~20–22% last 3 yrs; "minimum we want to grow").
- **Corporate loan book:** +12–13% by FY27-end (INR 14,000 cr already sanctioned, in disbursement) — recovering the -10% QoQ dip.
- **NIM:** maintained 3.3–3.4% (all TD repricing already done 6 months ago; CASA-led).
- **ROA:** ~1.46% by FY27-end (internal floor 1.20%; 1.4–1.5% over next 2–3 quarters); **NIM-driven**, not opex.
- **Credit cost:** 0.35–0.40% full-year FY27 (0.14% in Q1).
- **ECL:** total requirement ~INR 3,000 cr; INR 2,150 cr already provided (1,700 till Mar + 400 this Q); rest to be fully provided within FY27 — **not** taking the 4-year RBI dispensation.
- **ECLGS:** universe INR 4,400 cr; INR 2,600 cr disbursed; balance INR 1,800 cr → 95–100% by Aug-end / early-Sep.
- **Capital:** INR 5,000 cr equity + INR 1,000 cr Tier-2 approved; to hit market Q3/Q4 FY27 in 1–2+ tranches.
- **GIFT City:** build book to ~USD 500 mn by FY27-end (internal budget).
- **FCNR(B):** mobilised USD 300 mn; intend to double to USD 600–650 mn by Sep-2026 (dispensation window end).

- Deck claims IOB is "Amongst top 2 PSBs in number of loan disbursement via ULI" (RBIH Unified Lending Interface).

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body:
- **RAM (~80% of book):** primary yield + growth engine; big-ticket MSME/agri loans (INR 3–5 cr) classified RAM per RBI definition. Gold-backed = ~40% of agriculture general loans; no agri delinquencies seen/expected.
- **Corporate (~20%):** -10% QoQ purely from exiting one ~INR 10,000 cr low-priced account in Apr (~40% of impact absorbed in Q1); disciplined "no loss-making business at sub-7%".
- **International:** 4 countries; new GIFT City IFSC branch upcoming.
- **Digital:** ~96% of transactions digital; ~75% of customer onboarding digital; 10-min laptop/mobile loan sanction, 2-min digital locker allotment (Big-Four-led revamp 3–4 yrs ago).

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body: - Not an order-book model. Growth pipeline = corporate sanctions INR 14,000 cr in disbursement stages; RAM (~80% of book) uniformly growing; FCNR(B)/NRI mobilisation via 4 overseas centres + 4.5 lakh existing NRI customers; new GIFT City IFSC branch (USD 500 mn target book).

guidance.title: Guidance (CRITICAL — verify next quarter)
guidance.body:
- **Credit / advances growth:** 13–14% **minimum** FY27 (has run ~20–22% last 3 yrs; "minimum we want to grow").
- **Corporate loan book:** +12–13% by FY27-end (INR 14,000 cr already sanctioned, in disbursement) — recovering the -10% QoQ dip.
- **NIM:** maintained 3.3–3.4% (all TD repricing already done 6 months ago; CASA-led).
- **ROA:** ~1.46% by FY27-end (internal floor 1.20%; 1.4–1.5% over next 2–3 quarters); **NIM-driven**, not opex.
- **Credit cost:** 0.35–0.40% full-year FY27 (0.14% in Q1).
- **ECL:** total requirement ~INR 3,000 cr; INR 2,150 cr already provided (1,700 till Mar + 400 this Q); rest to be fully provided within FY27 — **not** taking the 4-year RBI dispensation.
- **ECLGS:** universe INR 4,400 cr; INR 2,600 cr disbursed; balance INR 1,800 cr → 95–100% by Aug-end / early-Sep.
- **Capital:** INR 5,000 cr equity + INR 1,000 cr Tier-2 approved; to hit market Q3/Q4 FY27 in 1–2+ tranches.
- **GIFT City:** build book to ~USD 500 mn by FY27-end (internal budget).
- **FCNR(B):** mobilised USD 300 mn; intend to double to USD 600–650 mn by Sep-2026 (dispensation window end).

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body:
- **GIFT City IFSC branch** — new international-monetisation lever (USD 500 mn book target FY27).
- **FCNR(B) / NRI leverage** — USD 300→600–650 mn doubling by Sep; taps 4.5 lakh NRI base.
- **DTA / capital efficiency** — INR 200 cr DTA added to net worth this Q.

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body:
- NIM 3.37% global / 3.48% domestic; +12 bps QoQ. Levers: yield on advances +10 bps QoQ (better pricing; 54% MCLR / 37% RLLR-linked) + cost of deposits -10 bps QoQ (aggressive CASA @ ~41%, bulk deposits kept to just 6–7% of total, all TD repricing already complete). Future ROA uplift framed as NIM-driven (both higher interest income and lower interest expense).
- Fee income +20% YoY to INR 476 cr (from 398 cr) — low-base optics; core exchange/commission/LC/BG/locker/processing.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: - INR 5,000 cr equity + INR 1,000 cr Tier-2 approved, to be raised Q3/Q4 FY27 (GoI 92.44%; also helps SEBI MPS). CAR already 19.36% vs 11.50% min — raise is offensive/growth + float, not distress. Accumulated losses fully cleared this quarter (enables future dividend capacity). ECL being front-loaded (no 4-yr dispensation) — conservative capital use.

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body: Highly confident, "consistency is our hallmark" tone from CEO Srivastava (11-quarter one-directional track record). Candid on the corporate-book exit rationale ("we do not want to do any loss-making business… not for sub-7% corporate"), transparent on ECL front-loading and the SMA2 uptick, and precise on data points (DTA/MTM bridge, SMA buckets, ECLGS split). Guides conservatively (13–14% "minimum") while over-delivering — a credibility-builder. No over-promising on NIM (held-band framing).

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body:
- **"Quality of beat":** PSLC INR 863 cr + tech-w/o recovery ~INR 490 cr are large; mgmt calls them recurring, but they inflate the headline vs pure operating earnings.
- **Corporate-book contraction:** -10% QoQ; recovery to +12–13% is a FY27-end promise to verify.
- **SMA2 tick-up:** +INR 500 cr QoQ (though total SMA down INR 2,200 cr) — monitor slippage.
- **Dilution / MPS optics:** INR 5,000 cr raise with GoI at 92.44%.
- **West Asia conflict:** "looming large again"; no product/sector stress seen yet in SME/small-borrower book.
- **ECLGS tail:** INR 1,800 cr still to disburse; CGTMSE/CGFMU cover ~15–16% of credit.

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body:
- A PSB printing **ROE 22.7% / ROA 1.41% / NIM 3.48% domestic** — better than most private peers — yet still trades/optically screens as a PSU; the re-rating question is whether the market fully credits the earnings quality.
- The **-10% QoQ corporate book is self-inflicted discipline**, not demand loss — a positive read once the +12–13% FY27 recovery lands.
- **Accumulated losses now nil** is a quiet but structural milestone (dividend capacity + cleaner capital math ahead of the raise).
- ECL being **fully provided within FY27 (no 4-yr dispensation)** removes a future overhang other PSBs will still be carrying.
- PSLC + tech-w/o recovery recurring "every quarter for 8–9 quarters" is the crux of the bull/bear debate on sustainable ROA.

qoq_log.body:

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Overseas book] Overseas advances of ₹16,133 Cr carry an 8.68% NPA ratio at Jun-26 — versus 0.95% domestic — and overseas NPAs of ₹1,399 Cr actually rose from ₹1,347 Cr at Jun-25 while domestic NPAs fell; the deck presents the table without commentary on this divergence.
- [NPA reduction mix] The Jun-26 quarter's gross NPA reduction of ₹316 Cr comprised cash recoveries ₹106 Cr, upgradation ₹35 Cr, write-offs ₹174 Cr and nil sale to ARCs, against fresh slippages of ₹195 Cr; recovery from technical write-off accounts was ₹497 Cr.
- [Two PCR definitions] The deck reports PCR on two bases and they differ materially: 97.67% including technical write-off versus 86.29% excluding technical write-off at Jun-26 — the headline slides quote only the 97.67% figure.
- [Award] Skoch Award for the "Compliance Apexion" project, unveiled by MD & CEO Shri Ajay Kumar Srivastava with EDs Shri Joydeep Dutta Roy and Shri Dhanaraj T.
- [Balance sheet units] The 30.06.2026 balance sheet is presented in Rs. In Lakhs (total ₹4,80,95,649 lakhs standalone) while every other slide is in Rs. In Crores — a unit switch to watch when comparing across slides.
